name: University of Suffolk
description: The University of Suffolk is a public university situated in Suffolk and Norfolk, England. The modern university was established in 2007 as University Campus Suffolk (UCS), the institution was founded as a unique collaboration between the University of East Anglia and the University of Essex. Suffolk is ranked 67th out of 121 by The Guardian University Guide and has several subjects ranked in the top 10 including History (#4) and Creative Writing (#8). Timestamps
